# Babula Shots Estudio — Photo Studio in Santo Domingo

> Professional photography studio in Santo Domingo. Portraits, headshots, fashion, food, corporate, and creative studio sessions with controlled lighting. Part of the Babula Shots RD network.

Owner: Michal Nikodem Babula
Contact: info@babulashotsrd.com · WhatsApp +1 809 720 9547
Rating: 4.9/5 from 98 Google reviews
Service area: Dominican Republic (studio in Santo Domingo, outdoor sessions available)
Languages: Spanish and English
Hours: Mon–Sun, 9:00–18:00 Atlantic Standard Time (UTC-4)
